why: receipt.json is registered as evidence and hashed by the state row, so its sentences are not edited. The review measured four of them as ahead of the facts; the corrected wording belongs here and the original stays readable.

corrections.quoted_from_receipt: negative_cases[3] "a model switch happens silently -> CAUGHT, settled is a separate row"
corrections.what_was_measured: reviewer mutant R04 removed the settled-run condition and all 46 rows stayed green
corrections.corrected: the settled half was unasserted before remediation. Two separate refusals, a recorded settled run, a completing positive control and mutants V02/V11/V13 now cover it.

corrections.quoted_from_receipt: deliverables[1].evidence names N08 for "the install is an empty stub or an alias to another vendor CLI"
corrections.what_was_measured: N08 mutates only the shim text, and the delegation guard reads one file
corrections.corrected: N08 covers the shim. The empty-stub leg is covered by N05/V05-class build-skip mutants; the package-wide delegation claim is withdrawn to P-R1-7's disclosed limit.

corrections.what_was_measured: round 1's own disclosed finding says M09 stopped the package compiling
corrections.corrected: M09 is a crashed mutant, not a caught one: the classifier only looked at the exit status, and a compile failure reported as a red run scored as caught. Round 2 and round 4 classify build breakage separately.

corrections.quoted_from_receipt: remaining_blocks[1] "chat ... owned by a later card"
corrections.what_was_measured: W05 contains only W05-01, W05-02, W05-03 and W05-99
corrections.corrected: chat is not a contract command; its refusal is the accepted W02-03 surface pinned by the accepted W05-02 check. The contract's required interactive entry is the bare command, and this card now implements it.
